# Suresh Kamrushi

> Personal portfolio and practical blog by Suresh Kamrushi, a project manager focused on shipping software. Articles cover software delivery, engineering, GitHub Pages, static-site publishing, and AI search visibility.

The site is published at [sforsuresh.in](https://sforsuresh.in). The blog index is available at [Blog](https://sforsuresh.in/blog/).

## About

- [Home](https://sforsuresh.in/): Portfolio and professional background.
- [Blog](https://sforsuresh.in/blog/): Article index covering software, teams, delivery, engineering, and practical web guides.

## Articles

- [How to Enable or Disable the Delete Confirmation Dialog in Windows 10](https://sforsuresh.in/enabledisable-delete-confirmation-windows-10/): Change the Recycle Bin setting that controls the confirmation prompt for ordinary file deletions.
- [Debugging SQL Server Insert Hangs: Blocking, Transactions, and Batch Failures](https://sforsuresh.in/sql-server-insert-hang-debugging-guide/): A diagnostic workflow for SQL Server and Python insert batches, covering blocking, transactions, constraints, waits, log space, and system procedures.
- [Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Architecture and Practical Guide](https://sforsuresh.in/retrieval-augmented-generation-rag-guide/): Explains RAG ingestion and retrieval pipelines, embeddings, chunking strategies, vector search, benefits, and trade-offs.
- [CQRS in Microservices: Design, Data Flow, and Trade-offs](https://sforsuresh.in/cqrs-design-pattern-microservices/): How commands, queries, and read models work in CQRS, with scaling benefits, eventual-consistency trade-offs, and guidance on when the added complexity is justified.
- [How to Help AI Search Find Your Blog](https://sforsuresh.in/ai-search-blog-visibility/): Search indexing, crawler access, clear page structure, and the optional `llms.txt` convention.
- [10 RAG Architectures Explained: A Practical Guide](https://sforsuresh.in/10-rag-architectures/): Ten retrieval-augmented generation patterns and when they may be useful.
- [How to Host Images for Your GitHub Blog: 3 Practical Options](https://sforsuresh.in/host-images-github-blog/): Compare storing images with a site, using GitHub issue attachments, or maintaining a separate media repository.
- [GitHub Pages Hosting Limits: Technical and Architectural Constraints](https://sforsuresh.in/github-pages-hosting-limits/): Static hosting architecture, usage limits, repository visibility, and suitability.
- [How to Preview an HTML Page on Your Computer](https://sforsuresh.in/preview-html-page-locally/): Preview a local HTML page using Python, VS Code Live Server, or Node.js.
- [How to Host a Single HTML Page on Your GoDaddy Domain](https://sforsuresh.in/host-static-html-page-godaddy/): Compare GitHub Pages and GoDaddy cPanel hosting for a static page.
- [How to Make a GitHub Repository Private—and What Changes](https://sforsuresh.in/make-github-repo-private/): Change repository visibility and understand related effects.
